items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Jay McShann directly; the name is introduced by the interviewer to clarify a band affiliation of a third party (Vic Dickenson).

ctx.x: No, he hadn't. He was with what band? I don't remember. Was it Kirk? Was that the band --
He was with Jay McShann, but that was later --
That was later. I think he was with --
